t: When fully charged with a $(l:resource_production/laser_drill)Laser Drill$() it will produce ores. Each ore that can produced has a weight based in the biome the machine is placed in and the depth the machine is configured to mine in. $(br2)Laser lenses increases the weight of an a produced ore. $(br2)Check JEI for values.
在由 $(l:resource_production/laser_drill)镭射钻$() 充满能量后，它会产出矿石。每种可产出的矿石都有一个权重，该权重取决于机器所在的生物群系以及设定的开采深度。$(br2)镭射透镜会提高某种产出矿石的权重。$(br2)具体数值请查看 JEI。
